overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus S-Line 3-Person Full Spectrum Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a luxurious and health-enhancing experience right in your home. Crafted from elegant Natural Pacific Cedar wood, this sauna is designed to promote muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation through its advanced 9 heating elements, including 3 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Carbon Panels. With a temperature range of 118°F-132°F, it can heat up to 140°F, making it perfect for indoor spaces like basements or fitness rooms. Enjoy the added benefits of an interior chromotherapy lighting system and Bluetooth connectivity for a truly personalized wellness retreat.
